newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - AlliedSignal Inc Q2 net rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - AlliedSignal Inc Q2 net rises.

text.p: First Call mean estimate for Q2 was $1.08 per share.
(Dollars in millions except per share amounts)
NOTE: EPS based on weighted average shares outstanding during each period: 282,691,905 vs 282,769,698.
There is no material dilutive effect on earnings per share of common stock due to common stock equivalents. All share and per share amounts are on a pre-split basis.
Adjusted values exclude the one-time impact from the sale of the hydraulic braking and anti-lock braking systems businesses as well as from repositioning and other charges.
